en.headline: Body of missing 64-year-old woman found in Yuen Long manhole
en.dek: Police discovered the body of Yeung during a missing-person inquiry on Tai Tong Shan Road on Tuesday afternoon; she had last been seen at her Kiu Hing Road home on 7 August.
body: The body of a 64-year-old woman surnamed Yeung was found in a manhole on Tai Tong Shan Road in Yuen Long on Tuesday afternoon while police were investigating a missing-person case.
Officers located the body at about 5:48 pm and she was pronounced dead at the scene. The cause of death remains to be determined by a post-mortem examination.
According to police, Yeung was last seen at her residence on Kiu Hing Road on the afternoon of 7 August. A social worker reported her missing on 14 August. Police are continuing inquiries.

zh.headline: 元朗失蹤64歲女子遺體於大棠山道沙井發現
zh.dek: 警方周二下午調查失蹤人口案時，在大棠山道一個沙井內發現楊姓女子遺體，事主8月7日最後於僑興路住所露面。
body: 警方周二下午約5時48分在元朗大棠山道調查一宗失蹤人口案件期間，於一個沙井內發現一名64歲姓楊女子的遺體，現場證實死亡。
據了解，事主為失蹤人士，8月7日下午最後在僑興路的住所露面後失去聯絡，一名社工於8月14日向警方報案。
警方正調查事件，死因有待驗屍後確定。
